- Minimal subsegmental atelectasis was noted in the posterior region.
- A stable calcified granuloma was observed, which is categorized as a lung lesion.
- Heart size and pleural spaces appeared normal across all reviewed cases.
- No acute bone abnormalities were found, indicating the absence of fractures.
